text:
alex: Heads-up — gitops preflight failed for eu-west-2-gpu cluster during the CNI addon bump.

maria: saw that, logs show taint change on nodegroup resources that the validation webhook denies.

alex: exact error from preflight:
```
error: admission webhook "gatekeeper.openpolicyagent.org" denied request: mutation failed: constraint "no-unsafe-taints" violated: taint key "dedicated" not allowed to change
```

sam: is that the new mixed-instance taint we added in TF? we did a TF apply last night to add spot fallback for cheaper bursts.

maria: yes — terraform changed nodegroup labels/taints to allow spot fallback. Gitops expects taints immutable unless cluster-operator does a rollout.

toni: infra-bot triggered the helm upgrade for cilium-1.14 while gitops tried to reconcile nodegroups. ordering race.

infra-bot: Deploy attempt: repo=infra-clusters, commit=5f3a2d7, pipeline=canary, step=preflight, result=failed

jordan: Cost note — the TF change was to add spot instances to reduce $/GPU, but rollout blocked. We still have on-demand only, so cost spike this week ~+18%.

alex: proposed plan: revert the TF taint change, let gitops apply CNI, then we coordinate a scheduled maintenance window to do nodegroup taint migration with cluster-operator.

maria: I can open a quick PR to revert and bump canary to 0 -> would that be safe for the production cluster in eu-west-2?

sam: yes, revert and re-run preflight. Also add a preflight gate to block concurrent addon upgrades when nodegroup spec drift is detected.

toni: +1. I'll add a check to the pipeline: if git diff contains "taints" on nodegroup, delay CNI helm upgrade and notify #eng-oncall.

alex: ok I'll file the revert PR and tag people, leaving a follow-up ticket for pipeline gating and cost monitoring.

maria: thanks — posting PR link once ready :pray:
